public_notarization.mechanism: frozen protocol commit pushed publicly to github.com/Roddric/diffusion-model before any post-2023 candidate-market observation is downloaded

population_synthesis.claim_boundary: covariance cannot rescue a failed primary state decision
population_synthesis.claim_trichotomy: each population claim is classified by the prespecified pass / fail / inconclusive rule; the one-time outcome is terminal for this candidate regardless of classification

europe_block_sensitivity.role: prespecified sensitivity analysis treating the integrated Alpine / Eurozone-adjacent markets as one replication unit; it cannot replace the primary population decision

post2023_ticker_attrition.rule: a frozen asset survives the one-time download only if it resolves and has non-missing returns on at least 80% of post-2023 benchmark sessions; survivors keep frozen manifest order; a market needs at least 15 survivors; dropped assets are recorded and never replaced

frozen_threshold.definition: median trailing-20-session benchmark-return standard deviation at the final context date of each 2023 validation origin
